translationRepairs: Songgotu of the Heseri clan, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner, was Sony's second son.
Songgotu of the Heseri clan, a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner, was Sony's second son.
s0002 has 滿洲正黃旗人; 正黃旗 is the Plain Yellow Banner, while Bordered Yellow would be 鑲黃旗, so the idiomatic must be corrected.
Songgotu, of the Heseri clan, was a bannerman of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner and the second son of Sony.
Songgotu, of the Heseri clan, was a bannerman of the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner and the second son of Sony.
The same 正黃旗 in s0002 requires Plain Yellow Banner in the literal; Bordered Yellow Banner invents 鑲.
Mingzhu, styled Duanfan, of the Nara clan and the Bordered Yellow Banner, was a grandson of Yehe beile Gintaisi.
Mingzhu, styled Duanfan, of the Nara clan and the Plain Yellow Banner, was a grandson of Yehe beile Gintaisi.
s0068 has 滿洲正黃旗人 for Mingzhu; Plain Yellow Banner matches 正黃旗, not Bordered.
Mingzhu, style name Duanfan, of the Nara clan, was a bannerman of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner and grandson of Yehe beile Gintaisi.
Mingzhu, style name Duanfan, of the Nara clan, was a bannerman of the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner and grandson of Yehe beile Gintaisi.
Literal likewise misreads 正黃旗 as Bordered; Plain Yellow Banner is the accurate rendering.
After an earthquake, Left Censor-in-Chief Wei Xiangsu reported Songgotu's abuse of power, greed, and license, and urged severe punishment.
After an earthquake, Left Censor-in-Chief Wei Xiangshu reported Songgotu's abuse of power, greed, and license, and urged severe punishment.
s0014 names 魏象樞; 樞 is shū, so Wei Xiangshu is correct and Xiangsu is a romanization error.
When an earthquake occurred, Left Censor-in-Chief Wei Xiangsu came to audience and set forth Songgotu's abuse of power, greed, and license, asking for severe punishment.
When an earthquake occurred, Left Censor-in-Chief Wei Xiangshu came to audience and set forth Songgotu's abuse of power, greed, and license, asking for severe punishment.
The same 魏象樞 requires Wei Xiangshu in the literal field; Xiangsu mismatches the graph 樞.
